propositions: CodeHealthConfig.enabled field has zero read sites in src/rebar; it is never consulted to gate structural metrics evaluation
code-health metrics (module_size_distribution, oversized_module_count, complexity_summary, duplication_summary) run regardless of the enabled flag default of False
metrics.py loads only scan_roots, size_cap, and size_near_fraction from CodeHealthConfig, never reading the enabled field
operator ruled to REMOVE the enabled field entirely rather than wire it to gate metric evaluation
removal requires adding warn-class tombstones for code_health.enabled config key and REBAR_CODE_HEALTH_ENABLED env var to prevent silent drops and alert operators
